 WWTI Watertown Follow Apply for FAFSA and TAP aid at JCC on December 5
 Gene Morse Wed, November 18, 2026 at 4:56 PM UTC 2 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. WATERTOWN, N.Y. (WWTI) – Prospective college students looking for assistance with the financial aid process can get hands-on help next month at Jefferson Community College (JCC). In collaboration with the State University of New York (SUNY) system's statewide Financial Aid Day, JCC will host a local event on Saturday, December 5, from 8 to 11 a.m. on the second floor of the Jules Center (Building 6).
 The event is open to students considering any SUNY institution, not just JCC. During the session, representatives from JCC's financial services office will be available to answer questions and guide students through completing their online Free Application for Federal Student Aid (FAFSA) and New York State Tuition Assistance Program (TAP) applications.
 All prospective college students are encouraged to submit a FAFSA form, which determines eligibility for federal and institutional aid, including loans, school aid, and work-study programs.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement To ensure there is enough time to finish the online applications before the event concludes, attendees are asked to arrive no later than 10:30 a.m. Students planning to complete their forms on-site must bring several key items:
 Social Security numbers
 Email addresses
 Parent or spouse contributor details
 Copies of 2025 federal and state tax returns
 Applicants will also need a Federal Student Aid (FSA) ID, which can be created ahead of time or during the event with staff assistance.
 Registration is required to attend. For additional information or to register, contact JCC Financial Services at 315-786-2437.
